plugins.name: leadmagic
plugins.description: Official LeadMagic GTM plugin for Claude Code. Connects to hosted MCP for B2B account research, work email discovery and validation, decision-maker search, hiring intent, ads research, bulk enrichment, and credit-aware workflows.

skills.name: account-research
skills.description: Research a company with LeadMagic MCP and summarize GTM signals. Use for account briefs, ICP fit, and sales-call prep.
skills.description_zh: 通过LeadMagic MCP研究公司并汇总市场销售信号，支持客户简报、ICP匹配和销售通话准备。

skills.name: ads-research
skills.description: Pull competitor ad creatives (Google, Meta, B2B) via LeadMagic MCP for messaging and competitive angles.
skills.description_zh: 通过LeadMagic MCP获取Google、Meta和B2B竞品广告素材，分析传播信息及竞争角度。

skills.name: bulk-enrichment
skills.description: Credit-safe CSV/list enrichment with LeadMagic MCP — balance, preview, submit, poll. Use for uploaded files or multi-row enrichment jobs.
skills.description_zh: 通过LeadMagic MCP按余额检查、预览、提交和轮询流程批量补充CSV或多行名单资料，控制积分消耗。

skills.name: contact-lookup
skills.description: Find or validate a work email for a B2B contact using LeadMagic MCP. Use when the user has a person plus company or an existing email.
skills.description_zh: 通过LeadMagic MCP根据人员与公司信息或既有邮箱，寻找验证B2B工作邮箱。

skills.name: credit-guard
skills.description: Always-on spend discipline for LeadMagic MCP — free helpers first, composites over chains, no duplicate lookups.
skills.description_zh: 规范LeadMagic MCP消耗，优先免费辅助工具、复合查询并避免重复查找。

skills.name: decision-makers
skills.description: Find executives and buyers at a company and attach work emails when possible via LeadMagic MCP.
skills.description_zh: 通过LeadMagic MCP查找公司的高管和买方，并尽可能附工作邮箱。

skills.name: get-started
skills.description: Onboard with LeadMagic MCP — check credits, run one company or one contact outcome, and confirm cost before spend. Use when a user is new to LeadMagic in Claude Code.
skills.description_zh: 为Claude Code中的LeadMagic新用户检查积分、完成一次公司或联系人查询，并在消耗前确认成本。

skills.name: hiring-intent
skills.description: Surface open roles and hiring velocity for prioritization using LeadMagic MCP jobs and hiring-signal tools.
skills.description_zh: 通过LeadMagic职位及招聘信号工具发现开放岗位和招聘速度，支持客户优先级判断。

skills.name: market-search
skills.description: Broad people, company, and jobs market search via LeadMagic MCP with unlimited-plan awareness and cursor pagination. Use when building full audiences, TAMs, account lists, or job-posting sweeps rather than single lookups.
skills.description_zh: 通过LeadMagic MCP进行人员、公司及职位的广泛市场搜索，考虑无限套餐并用游标分页，支持完整人群、TAM、客户名单或招聘扫描而非单次查询。
